sentences.text: The office registered a temperature anomaly, described as a warmth with no source, starting at 01:10 and ending at 04:50.
During this period, the observed temperature reached 22.2 °C, which was higher than the expected temperature of 21.4 °C.
This warmth was outside the expected range of 21.1 °C to 21.6 °C.
This sudden temperature rise in the office was probably due to a fluctuation in the building's climate control system.
